physicalNotes: Radius 0.191 Jupiter radii from Mallorquín et al. 2023 (2023A&A...671A.163M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...671A.163M/abstract): 13,655 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Mallorquín et al. 2023 (2023A&A...671A.163M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...671A.163M/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.06844888 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
